archimate:ApplicationService.name: Payments Service
archimate:ApplicationService.documentation:
Reusable common platform component for Homes England product teams to integrate payment capabilities into enterprise services. Available across all parts of the HE business and public-facing applications.
Containerised application component delivering common payment service capabilities. Developed using .NET core with HTML/JS/CSS frontend components.

properties.value: All Homes England Business Services & Public Access
